title: West Virginia's 1st Congressional District General Election, 2026
description: The 2026 general election for West Virginia's 1st Congressional District features incumbent Republican Carol Miller seeking a fifth term against Democratic nominee Vince George and independent candidate Isaiah Rucker. The district covers southern West Virginia, including Charleston and Huntington, and has a strong Republican lean (Cook PVI: R+22). Miller, a staunch conservative and Trump ally who serves on the House Ways and Means Committee, won her previous race with 66.4% of the vote in 2024. George, a retired public policy analyst and former teacher, ran on a platform of economic fairness, healthcare access, and environmental protection. The race is rated 'Solid R' by Cook Political Report, Inside Elections, and Sabato's Crystal Ball.
polling_note: No public opinion polls were found for this race. Major nonpartisan forecasters (Cook Political Report, Inside Elections, Sabato's Crystal Ball) all rate the district as 'Solid Republican' or 'Safe Republican.'

candidates.name: Carol Miller
candidates.summary: Carol Miller is the incumbent U.S. Representative for West Virginia's 1st Congressional District, first elected in 2018. She serves on the House Ways and Means Committee and is a staunch conservative ally of President Donald Trump, supporting limits on environmental regulations for coal and energy industries. Before Congress, she served more than a decade in the West Virginia House of Delegates and co-owns a bison farm with her husband.

career_history.title: U.S. Representative
career_history.description: Represents West Virginia's 3rd Congressional District (2019-2023) and 1st Congressional District (2023-present). Serves on the House Ways and Means Committee.

candidates.name: Vince George
candidates.summary: Vince George is a retired public policy analyst, former teacher, and community advocate running for Congress as a Democrat. He grew up in South Charleston and worked for decades helping West Virginians access SNAP, Medicaid, and other public benefits, as well as recruiting healthcare providers for rural communities. He also worked with environmental groups to advocate against mountaintop removal mining and served as campaign manager for Denise Giardina's independent gubernatorial run.

candidates.name: Isaiah Rucker
candidates.summary: Isaiah Rucker is an independent candidate running for U.S. House in West Virginia's 1st Congressional District. He describes himself as a MAGA activist and is running on a platform of conservative and America First principles. Rucker is one of three candidates in the general election alongside incumbent Republican Carol Miller and Democratic nominee Vince George.

forecast.rationale: No public polling is available for this race, limiting direct voter-data confidence. The forecast therefore relies on race fundamentals, which overwhelmingly point to a Republican hold. West Virginia's 1st District has a Cook PVI of R+22, making it one of the most Republican districts in the country. Incumbent Carol Miller won her previous election with 66.4% of the vote in 2024 and serves on the powerful House Ways and Means Committee. All three major nonpartisan forecasters (Cook Political Report, Inside Elections, Sabato's Crystal Ball) rate this race as 'Solid/Safe Republican.' The Democratic nominee, Vince George, is a retired public policy analyst who has not held elected office, and independent candidate Isaiah Rucker identifies as a MAGA conservative, which is unlikely to consolidate any meaningful anti-Miller vote. Given the district's strong GOP lean, incumbency advantage, and Miller's consistent electoral performance, a Republican victory is near-certain. However, the complete absence of public polling and the presence of a third candidate create modest uncertainty about the exact margin, keeping overall confidence at medium rather than high.
